mintAuthority.summary: At Ethereum block 26197360, USDU has two standing EOA minters with allowances of 500,000,000 and 469,238,483.27 USDU. An upgradeable MasterMinter controller contract manages these allowances; its owner and token/ProxyAdmin owner are the same EOA. Controller administration and immediate owner upgrades keep issuance economically unbounded; offchain key custody remains unverified.
mintAuthority.headline: Issuer-controlled minters have replenishable allowances, and the owner can immediately upgrade issuance logic; independent signing arrangements remain undisclosed.

controls.evidence: At block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z), token masterMinter() binds this transparent proxy; its implementation is 0xe4972d660340cd915ae10b19064ca4854f7ca32f and EIP-1967 admin is 0x5316d447decb4f2d3d3d44cc95528c7336a33062. getOwner() is 0x794e5b5a0a3375ff9dfaabd4e533c3adadc272c7; getControllerAdmin() is 0xbeffb4ae11b7066c8ffd45937ddba32ae2ab0cef; getMaxMinters()=6 and getMinterManager()=the USDU token. The existing controller census through block 26110183 is unchanged by complete token/MasterMinter event reads over blocks 26110184 through 26197360, which contain only transfers and approvals. getMinters(address), not getMinters(), returns the same two addresses; both remain token isMinter=true. The verified controller can replace and increase allowances without a mandatory delay. Six is a per-controller minter-count parameter, not a token supply limit. State and delta events were read at https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com.

controls.label: USDU token and ProxyAdmin owner
controls.evidence: At block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z), token getOwner(), MasterMinter getOwner() and their shared ProxyAdmin.owner() return this address; eth_getCode=0x and both pending owners are zero. The token implementation is 0x7df0b1f63e0a467b6aa95b4ed6d299dab9f73750. Verified ProxyAdmin allows immediate owner-only upgrade and upgradeAndCall on both token and MasterMinter. Token owner can also replace masterMinter; MasterMinter owner can replace controllerAdmin and minterManager. An EOA is the observed onchain authority, not proof of independent MPC operators or an offchain hold period. Reads: https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z), getControllerAdmin() returns this EOA and eth_getCode=0x. Verified configureController can activate a controller and assign a minter; setMaxNumberOfMinters changes the count parameter. The owner can replace this administrator. No enforced timelock is present in these functions. State read: https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com.

controls.label: USDU controller and first standing minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z), eth_getCode=0x; MasterMinter isController=true and token isMinter=true. getMinterAllowance=500000000000000 raw units (500,000,000 USDU). This controller is minterController for itself and for 0x934f15126f8749ec3d77f0e860ba2491900c317b. It can replace or increase both allowances, making the current numbers snapshots rather than irreversible supply bounds. Reads: https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z), eth_getCode=0x and token isMinter=true. getMinterAllowance=469238483270000 raw units (469,238,483.27 USDU); minterController returns 0xc6739fc8f7758a5721cbe13f2dc2d0913b26298f and isController=false for this second minter. review.evidence: Ethereum block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z), read through https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com, refreshes token owner, shared ProxyAdmin owner, MasterMinter owner/controllerAdmin, one standing controller and two direct minters. Complete token and MasterMinter event reads from block 26110184 through 26197360 contain only transfers and approvals, preserving the previously reviewed issuance/control census through block 26110183. Current getters independently confirm both minters, their controller mappings and replaceable allowances; totalSupply is 30,759,928.73 USDU. Immediate owner upgrades remain adverse known facts. Crowe monthly examinations and ADGM FSP250089 support periodic reserve reconciliation and prudential supervision, not a hard supply cap. The prior audit review records the whitepaper's May 6, 2025 CertiK reference and the Aquanow USDU archive's May 2 delivery; the similarly named BNB-chain ultracoin is a different asset. Exact audited-commit correspondence and independent MPC/operator custody remain unproved. The four scoped key-custody questions retain their original review dates: current EOA code reads establish no onchain quorum or timelock but do not refresh offchain policy evidence.
